title: events.jsonl line
description: One JSON object per line in events.jsonl (rotated at 1 MB). Names are a contract: the tray maps them to balloons and diagnose timelines read them, so a rename is a breaking change. Unknown names are ignored by readers.

ts.description: Local ISO-8601 timestamp of the write.

phase.description: State phase at the moment of the event.

event.description: Event name. golden.applied carries launch|reapply|guard|exit-restore in data; session.* carry the pid or a reason.

data.description: Short payload, never a user path (see SECURITY.md).
